senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָמַץ)bending the three middle fingers over the hollow of the hand; (with מלא, or sub. מלא) grab, handful, contrad. to חוֹפֶן.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3b:29">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הק׳ משביע וכ׳</he> one grab cannot satisfy a lion.

Gen. R. s. 20 ק׳ עפר וכ׳ is not the handful of dust of the ground of which thou hast been made, booty in thy possession (which thou must give back to the earth)? Gen. R. s. 90 אין בה ק׳ ק׳ there would not be a handful for each person; Yalk. ib. 148 אינן מספיקין מק׳ ק׳; a. e.—Esp. the handful of the meal offering which the priest takes to be put on the altar (Lev. VI, 8).
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 3:2">Men. III, 2</cite> <he>נתערב קוּמְצָהּ בק׳ וכ׳</he> if the handful of one meal offering became mixed up with that of another meal offering.
Ib. 3 ק׳ שנתערב וכ׳ if a ḳomets became mixed up with a meal offering from which no ḳomets was yet taken.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:4:5">Y. Shek. VI, end, 50ᵇ</cite> <he>בקֻמְצוֹ של כהן</he> measured by the officiating priest’s handful; <he>בק׳ של בעלים</he> by the owner’s handful.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6:1">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>חביב עלי מלא קמצו של עני וכ׳</he> the handful of the poor man’s offering is more precious to me than the fistfuls of the high priest’s frankincense; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְמָצִים</he>, <he>קְמָצִין</he>, <cite ref="S00637"><he>קוּמְצִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:7">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>חפנו</he> … <he>שמונה ק׳</he> Moses’ one fistful contained eight ordinary handfuls. Y. Shek. l. c. (ed. Zyt. <he>קומצין</he>); a. fr.
